args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). The docstring already said the right thing; the implementation didn't match.

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `quantize`.

## Verification
- `tests/test_money.py` now passes:
  - `2.675 -> 2.68` (rounds half to even)
  - `2.665 -> 2.66` (banker's rounding, the case the nightly build caught)
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`).
